reviews.quote: Engineering a Nation is without a doubt the most comprehensive survey of the life of Visvesvaraya.

notes: Metadata from Penguin Random House India (imprint India Viking, Sept 2024, ISBN 9780670090501) and Amazon.in. First published 2024; the 2025 hint reflects the year of its NIF Book Prize win (excluded from awards per instructions). One review verified via fetched India Forum page.

reviews.quote: This book moves beyond being a stereotypical description of Ambedkar's life and offers thought-provoking insights.

notes: Metadata from Navayana publisher page and Amazon (ISBN-10 8195838510 = ISBN-13 9788195838516). First edition Navayana 2023 (864 pp); the 2024 hint reflects the year of its NIF Book Prize win (excluded per instructions). One review verified via fetched India Forum page; other reviews were paywalled or returned 403.

reviews.quote: Akshaya Mukul has produced a splendid biography, one that will set the standard for serious academic work in Hindi.
As a chronicle of the life and times of a doyen, this book has few equals.

notes: Biography of Agyeya by Akshaya Mukul, first published July 2022 by Vintage (Penguin Random House India), hardback ISBN 9780670097210. Year hint of 2023 refers to a later printing/audiobook; first English edition is 2022. Two reviews verified by fetch (The India Forum, The Tribune); The Wire and Scroll pages returned errors/403.

reviews.quote: Shekhar Pathak catches every nuance of the people's struggle for their environment and contextualizes events contingent upon it like no other author could have.

notes: English edition published by Permanent Black (Ranikhet), 2021, ISBN 978-81-7824-555-3; translated from Hindi by Manisha Chaudhry. Won the NIF Book Prize 2022 (excluded from awards per instructions). Only one review (The Book Review) could be verified by fetch; the SAGE/Studies in Indian Politics review and a Scroll piece were paywalled or returned 403.

reviews.quote: Dinyar Patel's splendidly researched, elegantly written book traces the life of a memorable pioneer.
Patel has constructed a rounded portrait of a true 'Pioneer of Indian Nationalism' indeed.
Dinyar Patel keeps Naoroji the focus, so the book is recommended for keeping it simple.

notes: Metadata (Harvard University Press, 2020, ISBN 9780674238206) confirmed via Google Books; also co-published in India by HarperCollins. First-edition year is 2020, not the 2021 hint. Won the NIF Book Prize 2021 (excluded per instructions). Three reviews each from a distinct fetched page.

reviews.quote: The book 'Mobilizing the Marginalized' by Amit Ahuja is one of the most profound books concerning the field of comparative politics.

notes: First English edition is the OUP hardcover, 2019, ISBN 9780190916428 (confirmed via Google Books); a paperback in the Modern South Asia series, ISBN 9780190916435, followed. First-edition year is 2019, not the 2020 hint. Won the NIF Book Prize 2020 (excluded per instructions). Only one review quote could be verified from a directly fetched page (Outlook India); a Studies in Indian Politics review by Harish S. Wankhede is paywalled.

reviews.quote: The book is a massive achievement, on a man who was both an international phenomenon and a bundle of contradictions.

reviews.publication: The Round Table (Commonwealth Journal of International Affairs)
reviews.quote: The research is impressive, indeed exceptional by contemporary Indian standards

notes: Penguin Viking / Penguin Random House India, 2019, 744 pp, ISBN 978-0-670-09232-1 (confirmed via Journal of Asian Studies citation and publisher listings). Won the NIF Book Prize 2020 (excluded per instructions). The Hindu review quote taken from the reviewer Manu S. Pillai's own reproduction of his March 2020 Hindu review.

reviews.quote: It is built on such carefully compiled evidence, in concert with a lucid and compelling argument.
This is a book about how India operationalized its democracy, a story that, astonishingly, has not been told before by historians.

notes: Cambridge University Press hardback edition, ISBN 9781107188594; published online Nov 2017, print 2018 (also a Penguin India edition, ISBN 0670090751). Won the NIF Book Prize 2018 (excluded per instructions). Two reviews verified from fetched pages (Journal of Democracy, Pacific Affairs).
